request: Separate reusable treehouse body, balcony, stair flight, landing, large tree and dense bush in the supplied jungle artwork style.

credits.evidence: Official Meshy CLI balance audits: 1826 to 1721 for the original seven tasks; 1721 to 1691 for the host/cabin refinement.

moduleNotes.body: Front +Z; no attached balcony, tree or stairs.
moduleNotes.body-v2: More detailed 8K-target Meshy cabin, kept near its source proportions; 2K color and 1K normal atlas.
moduleNotes.host: Independent rooted load-bearing fork, with broad boughs physically beneath the deck.
moduleNotes.balcony-deck: Actual Meshy balcony deck extracted from the original module; separate source-authored ropes leave a correct stair entry.
moduleNotes.canopy: Upper crown extracted from the Meshy tree to keep foliage outside the cabin and its support junction.
moduleNotes.balcony: Open long edge -Z; deck contact plane normalized Y=1/6; total height1.5m gives deck top0.25m above bottom.
moduleNotes.stairs: Seven actual Meshy treads, open risers, no handrails; rise +Z to -Z; fitted normalized tread levels1/7 through1.
moduleNotes.landing: Flat top normalized Y=1; no rails or supports extending below module bounds.
moduleNotes.tree: Independent ancient tree; branches and foliage as solid geometry; bottom-anchored, canopy-only wind.
moduleNotes.bush: Independent dense foliage clump with thick leaf forms; bottom-anchored with wind.
